AiChoice.description: Which AI to ask: a provider by its id, and one of its models. The key and the address of the provider are the person's own and stay in the app's settings.

model.description: Empty for the model the settings choose for the provider.

provider.description: One of `AI_PROVIDERS`; empty for the one the app's settings choose.

screen.description: The AI that checks screens by meaning. A check that names its own provider still asks that one.

text.description: The AI that drafts tests and explains failed runs; `jev` only looks at screens, so it can't be this one.

reason.description: Why the test is in quarantine, such as a link to the bug that makes it fail.

test.description: Test file, relative to the project folder, with `/` between folders.

until.description: Last day the test is in quarantine, as `YYYY-MM-DD`; absent for a quarantine without an end.

Rect.description: A rectangle in fractions (0–1) of the image or window, from the top-left corner.

RunKind.description: Whether the tests of the folder run one after another or side by side.

oneOf.description: Several tests at once, each in its own copy of the application.

RunModeEntry.description: How the tests of one folder run.

folder.description: Relative to the project folder, with `/` between folders; `.` is the project folder.

limit.description: Most tests that run at once, for `parallel` only.

description: Settings a project shares with everyone who runs its tests, in `jevision.project.json` in the project folder: retries, tests in quarantine, areas covered in every screenshot, the AI the project asks and the folders whose tests run side by side. API keys never go in this file.

ai.description: The AI the project asks, when it doesn't leave the choice to the app's settings.

format.description: Version of the layout of the file. JEVision doesn't open a file in a format newer than it knows.

hide.description: Areas of the window, in fractions from its top-left corner, covered in every screenshot before it is saved or sent to an AI model.

localOnly.description: Screenshots go only to AI models running on this computer; checks that would need a cloud service fail instead.

quarantine.description: Tests in quarantine: they still run, but their failure doesn't fail Run All, the command line or the JUnit report until their last day is past.

retries.description: How many times a failed test is retried when its file doesn't say; without it, none.

runModes.description: How the tests of folders run. A folder without an entry runs like the nearest folder above it that has one; the project folder, without one, runs one test after another.

suggestQuarantineAfter.description: Flaky runs of a test within 7 days after which quarantine is suggested.

title: JEVision project settings
